text_plugin_synopsis: Secure image editing and conversion for AutoJs6 Explorer
p_languages_all_supported_for_readme: The current README.md supports the following languages
p_introduction: The AutoJs6 Image Tools plugin provides independent edit and convert overflow actions for a single image in the main Explorer. It reads the source without modifying it and writes only to a host-owned output transaction.
features: Edit images with crop, rotation, horizontal and vertical flip, brightness, contrast, saturation, color temperature, brush strokes, text, and undo.
Convert to JPEG, PNG, or WebP with quality control, percentage or custom resizing, aspect-ratio locking, and JPEG background selection.
Decode through ContentResolver and ParcelFileDescriptor without raw paths or BitmapFactory.decodeFile.
Encode only to the exact output URI supplied by AutoJs6 and report success by echoing only the output transaction ID.
p_supported_formats: The plugin validates image contents through Android decoding rather than trusting an extension or declared MIME type
p_plugin_interface: AutoJs6 discovers and executes the plugin with the following identities
p_plugin_scope: Version 1 registers two protocol v3 overflow actions only on the main Explorer surface. Each action accepts one read-only source image and creates one new sibling through the host output transaction. The source is never replaced.
p_plugin_packaging: The plugin is implemented entirely on the JVM and contains no native library. It declares `supportedAbis = emptyArray()` and is released as one ABI-independent APK. AutoJs6 host build 5269 or later is required.
p_security: The plugin requests no storage or network permission. It rejects non-v3 requests, non-main surfaces, unexpected actions, parent URIs, extra ClipData items, writable source grants, non-content URIs, malformed transaction IDs, unsupported output MIME types, and output limits above 256 MiB. The output URI is never returned to the caller.
security_limits: One read-only input image and one exact host-owned output URI per action.
Maximum declared input and encoded output size: `{{ max_input_size }}`.
Output is restricted to JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
Image dimensions, pixel count, decode sampling, conversion memory, history storage, and encoded byte count are bounded.
Cancellation returns `RESULT_CANCELED`; success returns only the matching transaction ID.
p_build_params: Build parameters come from `version.properties`. The current minimum SDK is 24 and the target SDK is 36
p_resource_layout: `strings.xml` localizes plugin metadata and UI text. `plugin_instruction.md` provides instructions shown by the host. `.python/generate_markdown.py` generates localized README and changelog files from JSON sources
